an3.20:1.1: tīhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato pāpaṇiko nacirasseva mahantattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti bhogesu
an3.20:1.3: idha bhikkhave pāpaṇiko cakkhumā ca hoti vidhūro ca nissayasampanno ca.
an3.20:1.6: idaṃ paṇiyaṃ evaṃ kītaṃ evaṃ vikkayamānaṃ ettakaṃ mūlaṃ bhavissati ettako udayoti
an3.20:1.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave pāpaṇiko cakkhumā hoti.
an3.20:2.2: idha bhikkhave pāpaṇiko kusalo hoti paṇiyaṃ ketuñca vikketuñca
an3.20:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave pāpaṇiko vidhūro hoti.
an3.20:3.2: idha bhikkhave pāpaṇiko ye te gahapatī vā gahapatiputtā vā aḍḍhā mahaddhanā mahābhogā te naṃ evaṃ jānanti
an3.20:3.3: ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ pāpaṇiko cakkhumā ca vidhūro ca paṭibalo puttadārañca posetuṃ amhākañca kālena kālaṃ anuppadātunti
an3.20:3.5: ito samma pāpaṇika bhoge haritvā puttadārañca posehi amhākañca kālena kālaṃ anuppadehīti
an3.20:3.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave pāpaṇiko nissayasampanno hoti.
an3.20:3.7: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi aṅgehi samannāgato pāpaṇiko nacirasseva mahantattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti bhogesu.
an3.20:4.1: evameva kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nacirasseva mahantattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti kusalesu dhammesu
an3.20:4.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhumā ca hoti vidhūro ca nissayasampanno ca.
an3.20:4.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti … ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an3.20:4.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhumā hoti.
an3.20:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu
an3.20:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vidhūro hoti.
an3.20:6.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā so te kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā paripucchati paripañhati
an3.20:6.3: idaṃ bhante kathaṃ imassa ko atthoti
an3.20:6.4: tassa te āyasmanto avivaṭañceva vivaranti anuttānīkatañca uttānīkaronti anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhaṭṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti
an3.20:6.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu nissayasampanno hoti.
an3.20:6.6: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nacirasseva mahantattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti kusalesu dhammesūti.
